cd /workspace/project && timeout 30 python3 - <<'PY'
import random,time,json
from syntax import parse_policy
from ebpf.helper import Agent
random.seed(508)
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)]
services=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
base='(startswith(A,B) and contains(C,D)) allow;(endswith(D,A) or match(E)) allow;(contains(C,D) and startswith(A,B)) drop;(startswith(A,B) and (contains(C,D) or endswith(D,A))) allow;(endswith(D,A) and contains(C,D)) allow;'
N=7200
S=set()
while len(S)<N:S.add(tuple(random.randrange(16) for _ in range(7)))
text=base+''.join('match('+','.join(names[i] for i in t)+') allow;' for t in S)
p=parse_policy(text);print('atoms',p.atoms,'paths',p.path_symbols)
a=Agent(services,{'images':1,'cells':262144,'units':1,'contexts':1,'connections':1,'packets':1,'files':1})
t=time.time();r=a.event({'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':text},parsed=p);print('time',time.time()-t,'ok',r.get('ok'),'rows',len(r['image']['rows']) if r.get('ok') else None)
print(a.event({'op':'inspect'})['images'])
PY
